changelog:
- Initial release of WhisperX speech recognition skill for OpenClaw.
- Provides high-quality, fully offline speech-to-text transcription using OpenAI Whisper technology.
- Supports more than 90 languages with auto language detection and word-level timestamps.
- Offers optional speaker diarization (requires HuggingFace token).
- No internet or API key required; works with standard audio formats via ffmpeg integration.
- Pure ASR: converts voice messages to text only, does not generate voice replies.
summary: WhisperX provides local speech-to-text transcription using OpenAI Whisper, with high-quality offline recognition, no API key required, word-level timestamps,...
